summary: Provision scoped cross-project service role for ML deployment fleet (least-privilege, timeboxed)
description: Issue summary: Request to create a delegated, time-limited service role that allows the ML Infra team to perform model deployment operations across the 'ml-fleet-prod' projects without granting secrets access or broad owner privileges. Business justification: Enables engineers to rollout model versions and manage rollout policies for Redwood Dedicated clusters while maintaining least-privilege and auditability. Desired lifetime for each grant: up to 8 hours (JIT).
impact: If not provided, ML deploys for scheduled canary rollouts will require manual escalation and slow down critical releases. Current workaround is to request full owner elevation from cloud-admin, which increases blast radius and delays deployments.
proposed_design:
- Role name: roles/redwood.mlFleetDeployScoped (GCP) and redwood-ml-fleet-deploy (AWS IAM assume-role).
- Permissions (GCP): compute.instances.get/list, compute.instances.update for annotated nodes, iam.serviceAccounts.actAs limited to redwood-ml-service-sa-*. No access to secretsmanager/secretmanager.access. Limited pubsub/publisher for rollout messages.
- Permissions (AWS): sts:AssumeRole on redwood-ml-deploy-<env> with session tags, EC2 Describe/DescribeInstances, ECS UpdateService, ECR Pull, no KMS/SecretsManager:Decrypt.
- Impersonation model: Use service-account impersonation (gcloud iam service-accounts impersonate) and short-lived STS sessions for AWS.
- Conditions: Bind only when caller has tag "requester_team=ml-infra" and request contains justification tag. Enforce access with IAM Conditions on GCP and role session tags + IAM policy on AWS.
acceptance_criteria: Role created in target projects with documented policy and no permissions to read secrets or modify org-level settings
JIT access flow validated: engineers can request up to 8h session via internal-portal and receive short-lived creds
Audit logs emit caller identity, session tags, justification, and linked ticket ID
Automated policy tests (terraform plan/apply in dry-run) included in PR and reviewed
Security sign-off recorded in Confluence page linked below
steps_to_reproduce_or_test: 1) Create a test model rollout in staging using the new role impersonation; verify deployment pipeline completes without needing additional secrets access.
2) Request a JIT session via /internal-access portal with tag 'ml-deploy-test' and verify 8-hour cred issuance and audit entry in GCP Audit Logs and CloudTrail.
3) Attempt a secrets read (Secret Manager/KMS/SecretsManager) using the granted session — must fail with permission denied.
4) Simulate rollback: revoke the JIT session and confirm sessions are invalidated and cannot be used for subsequent API calls.
